checks.title: Manual: legacy authentication is blocked tenant-wide
checks.audit: Entra ID > Conditional Access > Policies. Confirm a policy blocks 'Other clients' / legacy authentication for all users, with no exclusions besides break-glass accounts.
checks.rationale: Legacy auth (POP, IMAP, SMTP AUTH, MAPI) bypasses MFA.
checks.remediation: Create a Conditional Access policy: Users=All, Cloud apps=All, Client apps=Exchange ActiveSync + Other clients, Grant=Block.

checks.title: Manual: MFA required for all users via Conditional Access (or Security Defaults)
checks.audit: Entra ID > Conditional Access. Confirm a baseline 'Require MFA for all users' policy exists, or that Security Defaults are enabled.
checks.rationale: Tenant-wide MFA is the strongest single control against account takeover.
checks.remediation: Create a CA policy: Users=All, Cloud apps=All, Grant=Require MFA. Exclude only named break-glass accounts.

checks.title: Manual: Self-Service Password Reset (SSPR) requires 2 methods
checks.audit: Entra ID > Password reset > Authentication methods. Confirm 'Number of methods required to reset' = 2.
checks.rationale: Single-method SSPR is bypassed by SIM swap; require two.
checks.remediation: Set methods required = 2; enable authenticator app + security questions or phone.

checks.title: Manual: Exchange Online external sender warning is enabled
checks.audit: Run 'Get-ExternalInOutlook' in Exchange Online PowerShell. Confirm 'Enabled = True'.
checks.rationale: External sender warning helps users identify phishing from spoofed domains.

checks.title: Manual: Exchange Online auto-forwarding to external recipients is blocked
checks.audit: In the Exchange Admin Center: Mail flow > Remote domains > Default. Confirm 'AutoForwardEnabled' = False.
checks.rationale: BEC actors often set forwarding rules to exfiltrate mail.

checks.title: Manual: Safe Links and Safe Attachments policies cover all users
checks.audit: Defender Portal > Email & collaboration > Policies & rules > Threat policies. Confirm Safe Links + Safe Attachments policies are enabled and applied to all recipient domains.
checks.rationale: Safe Links and Safe Attachments protect against phishing URLs and malicious attachments.
checks.remediation: Defender Portal > Threat policies > New policy of each type, applied to recipient domains.

checks.title: Manual: SharePoint external sharing restricted to specific domains or guests
checks.audit: SharePoint admin center > Policies > Sharing. Confirm external sharing is 'New and existing guests' or stricter; not 'Anyone'.
checks.rationale: Anonymous link sharing is a recurrent data-leak vector.
checks.remediation: SharePoint admin center > Sharing > set to 'New and existing guests' and configure allowlist of domains.

checks.title: Manual: OneDrive default sharing link is 'people you specify'
checks.audit: SharePoint admin center > Policies > Sharing > File and folder links. Confirm 'Specific people' is the default.
checks.rationale: Anyone-link defaults silently expose internal documents.
checks.remediation: Set the default link type to 'Specific people (only the people the user specifies)'.

checks.title: Manual: Microsoft 365 audit log search is enabled
checks.audit: Defender Portal or Purview > Audit. Confirm 'Audit log search' is on. Validate with Search-UnifiedAuditLog PowerShell.
checks.rationale: Without unified audit logging, BEC and insider activity cannot be reconstructed.

checks.title: Manual: Microsoft Defender Secure Score is reviewed monthly
checks.audit: Defender Portal > Secure Score. Confirm a documented monthly review cadence and remediation backlog.
checks.rationale: Secure Score is Microsoft's running posture assessment for the tenant.
checks.remediation: Schedule a monthly Secure Score review and burndown of recommended actions.
